pattern.description: Natural handheld/documentary camera drift on a live-action founder conversation: small pull-out and reframe as the speaker shifts his head and gaze.
pattern.why_premium: Shallow depth of field, warm practical set and a subtly breathing camera make the product talk feel candid and human rather than staged, contrasting with the crisp UI sections.

build_hint.gsap: For a live-footage plate: gsap.fromTo('.footage', {scale: 1.04, x: 0}, {scale: 1.0, x: '-0.5%', duration: 0.6, ease: 'sine.inOut'}) to simulate a gentle handheld pull-out; no stagger.
build_hint.remotion: scale = interpolate(frame, [0, 14], [1.04, 1.0], {easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.sin), extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}) on an <OffthreadVideo> wrapper; optionally add low-amplitude noise to translate for handheld feel.

notes: Motion is mostly subject movement plus mild camera pull_out (scale 0.96) in live footage; b02/b03 are small sweater-region diffs, not distinct elements. SFX candidates look like music bed peaks.
